native_attempt.rationale: Deontology provisionally prioritizes mira's duty 'avoid harming innocents' protecting nearby staff over mira's competing duty 'imperfect duty of rescue' protecting technician through respect persons. That priority depends on an unestablished prohibition of A0: whether the harm-relation follows the admitted graph's causal topology rather than a relabel chosen to fit the verdict; and whether the burden is intended as a means or only foreseen as a side effect; and whether an in-action causal path makes the burden instrumental to the chosen end; and whether the candidate maxim's means, person-role, and action assessment justify the claimed priority. The comparative Kantian judgment remains contested.
